value.rationale: The precise finite-dimensional invariant is motivated by sharp short-time conditioning along curved observation traces. It is the first resonance among the natural symmetric three-, five-, seven-mode hierarchy: the lower Gram eigenvalue changes from order \(T^{12}\) to \(T^{14}\) at one explicitly determined nonzero curvature magnitude, while analytic independence persists. Thus the result identifies a structural exceptional boundary, not a random finite determinant or a routine substitution. Higher-mode and sharp-leading-constant questions remain open.
